EXERCISE — FICTIONAL

1. Communications passed in the clear establish that bulk carrier Mirenda transmits an implausible speed-over-ground for its class.

2. Entities identified in this reporting: Mirenda.

3. Callsigns associated with the activity were used 5 times in the period, against a baseline of fewer than 5 in comparable periods.

4. The activity was passed at 1110Z and repeated at 0016Z. No further traffic on the subject was recovered before collection ended at 1028Z.

5. A gap in collection between 1914Z and 1234Z cannot be excluded, and activity during that window would not have been recovered.

6. The reporting establishes that the activity occurred but not why it was ordered.
